What filtering works from

Conditions come from existing fields: Incomplete, this week, and assigned to me map to task status, date, and owner fields. When several conditions combine, the interface should show what currently limits the list.

Results should be recoverable: Clearing one condition or resetting all filters should return people to the full collection. An empty state should say conditions caused it, not imply the data vanished.

What it is not

Filtering is not search or sorting. Search finds candidates from entered words, filtering excludes by existing properties, and sorting only changes the order of current results. For example, showing incomplete tasks does not automatically put the most urgent first.
